$comment: Single source of truth for the three Log Analytics tables and their DCR input streams.
Consumers: azure/bicep/modules/tables.bicep and dcr.bicep (loadJsonContent: table columns and
stream declarations are generated from this file, so they cannot drift from each other) and
azure/tests/run.sh (compares these columns with the rows Vector really emits).
Types are the data collection rule stream types: string, int, long, real, boolean, datetime,
dynamic. The tables API spells datetime as dateTime; the Bicep module converts it.
Changing a column: add it here and redeploy FIRST, wait a few minutes for the schema to
propagate, and only then let azure/vector/vector.yaml emit it. Never rename or retype a column
in place; add a new one. TimeGenerated is written by the Vector sink from the event timestamp.

events.description: IB Gateway container events (one row per line of events/events.jsonl, log contract v2).

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Event time (UTC) from the event's ts field.

columns.name: Instance
columns.description: IBGW_INSTANCE label of the gateway that emitted the event.

columns.name: Host
columns.description: HOST_LABEL of the Docker host; empty when the operator did not set it.

columns.name: BootId
columns.description: 16 hex characters identifying one container start (boot_id).

columns.name: Seq
columns.description: Sequence number, monotonic per BootId; a gap means lost events.

columns.name: Src
columns.description: Emitting component: entrypoint, ibc, xvfb, vnc, socat, doctor or metrics.

columns.name: Level
columns.description: info, warn or error.

columns.name: Event
columns.description: snake_case event name, for example login_completed or twofa_initiated.

columns.name: Phase
columns.description: Gateway phase attached to the event, when the event carries one.

columns.name: Code
columns.description: Numeric code attached to the event, for example IB API code 1100; empty when absent.

columns.name: AccountTail
columns.description: Last three characters of an IBKR account id; the full id never leaves the host.

columns.name: Msg
columns.description: Human-readable message; never a raw IBC or Gateway line.

columns.name: Props
columns.description: Every other key of the event line, kept as a JSON object.

metrics.description: IB Gateway container resource samples (one row per line of metrics/metrics.jsonl, every 30 s). A value that was not measured is empty, never 0.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Sample time (UTC) from the sample's ts field.

columns.name: Instance
columns.description: IBGW_INSTANCE label of the gateway that emitted the sample.

columns.name: Host
columns.description: HOST_LABEL of the Docker host; empty when the operator did not set it.

columns.name: BootId
columns.description: 16 hex characters identifying one container start (boot_id).

columns.name: Seq
columns.description: Sequence number, monotonic per BootId.

columns.name: Phase
columns.description: Gateway phase when the sample was taken (logged-in, 2fa-pending, needs-human, ...).

columns.name: MemWorkingSetBytes
columns.description: Container memory working set in bytes (mem_working_set_bytes).

columns.name: MemLimitBytes
columns.description: Container memory limit in bytes (mem_limit_bytes); empty when unlimited or unknown.

columns.name: OomKills
columns.description: Cumulative OOM kills of the container's cgroup (oom_kills).

columns.name: CpuUsageUsec
columns.description: Cumulative CPU time in microseconds (cpu_usage_usec).

columns.name: CpuThrottledUsec
columns.description: Cumulative throttled CPU time in microseconds (cpu_throttled_usec).

columns.name: Pids
columns.description: Number of processes and threads in the cgroup (pids).

columns.name: JavaRssBytes
columns.description: Resident set size of the Gateway JVM in bytes (java_rss_bytes).

columns.name: JavaThreads
columns.description: Thread count of the Gateway JVM (java_threads).

columns.name: OpenFds
columns.description: Open file descriptors of the Gateway JVM (open_fds).

columns.name: CloseWaitSockets
columns.description: API sockets stuck in CLOSE_WAIT (api_close_wait_sockets).

columns.name: DiskFreeBytesLogs
columns.description: Free bytes on the log volume (disk_free_bytes_logs).

columns.name: DiskFreeBytesSettings
columns.description: Free bytes on the settings volume (disk_free_bytes_settings).

raw.description: Redacted raw IBC and launcher log lines (opt-in). IBKR encrypts the Gateway's own logs on disk; those are not here.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Time (UTC) at which the shipper read the line; the line's own timestamp stays inside RawData.

columns.name: RawData
columns.description: The log line after redaction, at most 32,768 bytes.

columns.name: FilePath
columns.description: Path of the source file inside the log volume.

columns.name: Computer
columns.description: HOST_LABEL of the Docker host; empty when the operator did not set it.

columns.name: Instance
columns.description: IBGW_INSTANCE label of the gateway that wrote the line.

columns.name: Level
columns.description: error or warn when the line says so; empty when the line carries no level.

columns.name: Code
columns.description: Error code found in the line (code=1100 style); empty when none.

columns.name: Truncated
columns.description: true when the line was longer than the limit and was cut.
